aboutGame.title: What is Animal Daycare Anomaly?
paragraphs: Animal Daycare Anomaly is a Roblox survival horror and management game from Day Dreams Games. You run a daycare for animal youngsters by day, admitting visitors at the front desk, cooking the meals they request, running playroom mini-games, and soothing anyone whose stress meter climbs too high.

The twist arrives with the guests. Some arrivals are mimics whose disguises carry physical, behavioral, or audio flaws, and anything you admit during the day turns hostile after dark. Shifts move through morning intake, midday care, evening lockdown, and a night phase where you watch hallway cameras, reset breakers, and keep every real child accounted for.

modules.name: Animal Daycare Anomaly Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of the core daycare shift loop, covering visitor checks, suspicious cases, animal care, and the nighttime events that end a run.

highlights.detail: Screen every arrival at the front desk, checking paws, eyes, shadows, and identification cards before you unlock the gate.
Cook the meal each child requests in the kitchen and serve it before the hunger meter empties.
Run playroom mini-games to burn off toddler energy and keep the facility panic meter low.
Calm agitated animals with snacks and soothing before their stress spreads across the whole room.
Sweep the camera feeds for hallway changes, then board up doors and windows during dusk lockdown.
Survive the night shift by watching monitors, resetting breakers, and staying out of unlit corridors.

modules.name: Animal Daycare Anomaly Anomalies Guide
modules.description: A detection guide to the abnormal visitors, suspicious behaviors, and hidden clues you meet during daycare inspections, so you can judge which arrivals are safe.

highlights.label: Six Claws
highlights.detail: Extra digit syndrome shows six claws or an added jointed finger during the paw inspection.

highlights.label: Black Eyes
highlights.detail: Inverted sclera reads as fully black or milky white eyes under a flashlight exam.

highlights.label: Fur Drift
highlights.detail: Texture drift makes a fur pattern ripple or shift while the visitor stands perfectly still.

highlights.label: Jaw Drop
highlights.detail: A jaw extension unhinges the lower jaw every time the visitor speaks.

highlights.label: No Shadow
highlights.detail: A missing shadow under the bright counter lights is one of the fastest low-risk tells.

highlights.label: No Mirror
highlights.detail: A hollow reflection leaves the desk mirror showing empty space behind the child.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the questions new caretakers ask most about Animal Daycare Anomaly.

items.question: What is Animal Daycare Anomaly?
items.answer: Animal Daycare Anomaly is a Roblox survival horror and management game from Day Dreams Games. You run a daycare for animal youngsters, feeding them, playing mini-games, keeping their stress low, and inspecting every visitor who arrives at the front desk.

items.question: How do I spot an anomaly in Animal Daycare Anomaly?
items.answer: Check each visitor against the normal baseline from top to bottom. Anomalies tend to show extra claws or digits, inverted black or milky eyes, fur that ripples while standing still, a lower jaw that unhinges when speaking, a missing shadow, or no reflection in the desk mirror.

items.question: What happens during the night shift in Animal Daycare Anomaly?
items.answer: After 21:00 the game switches from management to survival. You monitor hallway cameras, reset tripped breakers during blackouts, keep every real child accounted for, and banish anything that got inside during the day. A single breach that reaches the sleeping quarters ends the shift.

items.question: Does Animal Daycare Anomaly have codes?
items.answer: Yes. Active Animal Daycare Anomaly codes grant daycare coins, snack crates, camera battery packs, a flashlight skin, a temporary cash boost, and a cosmetic lobby title. Codes are case-sensitive and are entered from the main lobby interface.

items.question: How many players can join a shift in Animal Daycare Anomaly?
items.answer: Servers hold up to 25 players. In co-op you can split the work into Intake Screener, Activity Caretaker, Surveillance Monitor, and Nighttime Sentinel so that the entrance, kitchen, camera desk, and perimeter are all covered at once.

items.question: What is the fastest way to unlock security upgrades in Animal Daycare Anomaly?
items.answer: Earn Security Clearance Points by denying entry to anomalies at the inspection desk, then spend them on the UV flashlight module and thermal lens sensor first. Those two upgrades make every later intake check faster, which compounds into more points per shift.
